findings.description: Second row c1/c2 hard path cuts silver fish bodies/fins into incompatible shapes, with conspicuous jagged discontinuities and small tray-edge mismatch. Tray overall placement agrees with layout.
Second-row c3/c4 join produces a small abrupt step in the bright upper edge of the diagonal front rail. Main rail angle remains consistent.
Rear rim of red-fish tray has a small step at second-row c3/c4 hard join. Fish remain recognizably fish; repair should align the rim without changing its overall slope.
Three wood faces cross the first/second row with jagged horizontal tone/grain bands. Central post is particularly visible; silhouettes do not shift.

Three conspicuous zones: left front post, front counter corner, and central bright post/rear support. Hard jagged changes in wood tone/grain; silhouettes and rail direction remain connected. These are additional to F04 row1/2 bands.
findings.actionWhenGateReleased: Local material continuity repair only; retain object boundaries and source world placement.

findings.description: Front post above its foot has an abrupt jagged horizontal light/dark change through both faces. No lateral silhouette jump.
findings.actionWhenGateReleased: Restore continuous wood tone and grain across the join without changing post footprint.

findings.description: The right front wooden leg receives a new thick pale-gold, stone-like sleeve/block in p04_03. Its bottom is near local y410 rather than the submitted target near y315, about 95 pixels lower. The block widens beyond the shaft. Pure layout shows the original wooden foot and dark ground contact, without a resolved pale pedestal.
findings.actionWhenGateReleased: Remove added thick sleeve and end original wood foot within the intended footprint; do not widen the stall or move road.

findings.description: An additional horizontal wood-face tone band occurs outside the core in the right 115-pixel halo. It must not silently become the anchor for the right neighbor.
findings.actionWhenGateReleased: Include this existing post band in a future shared-boundary review/repair; no new-coordinate generation is authorized by this report.

watchOnly.description: A faint angled shade boundary is visible on the leftmost wood face at the row2/3 join. Lower priority than F05; no silhouette or route change confirmed.
